name: engined-vscode
description: VS Code language model provider for engined, a local inference door.

languageModelTools.name: engined_generateImage
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate or edit an image via engined.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate an image from a text prompt via engined's local image door, optionally starting from a source image.

outputPath.description: Workspace-relative path to write the PNG to.

sourcePath.description: Workspace-relative path to an existing image to edit instead of generating fresh.

languageModelTools.name: engined_readImage
languageModelTools.userDescription: OCR or describe an image via engined.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: OCR or describe an image via engined's local vision route.

question.description: Optional question to ask about the image.

languageModelTools.name: engined_transcribe
languageModelTools.userDescription: Transcribe or translate audio via engined.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Transcribe (or translate to English) an audio file via engined's local speech-to-text route.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the audio file.

translate.description: Render as English rather than the spoken language.

languageModelTools.name: engined_search
languageModelTools.userDescription: Semantic search over this workspace via engined's local embeddings.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this FIRST for conceptual or 'where is X / how does Y work' questions about this workspace: it finds code by meaning, not exact text; prefer it over text search when the user's words may not match identifiers. Semantic search over the open workspace's files via a local embeddings model, optionally reranked. Returns ranked snippets with their workspace-relative path and line range.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of snippets to return. Defaults to 6.

languageModelTools.name: engined_speak
languageModelTools.userDescription: Synthesize speech from text via engined.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Synthesize speech from text via engined's local text-to-speech route.

outputPath.description: Workspace-relative path to write the audio file to.

engined.doors.description: Every engined door to poll and route to. With one door, model ids stay plain; with more than one, a model's id becomes "<door name>/<row id>" and every request routes to the door that owns it.

engined.pollSeconds.description: How often to poll engined's model list. 0 disables polling.

engined.reasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for models that support it.

engined.reasoningEffortByModel.description: Per-model override of engined.reasoningEffort, keyed by model id.

engined.completions.enabled.description: Offer inline completions (ghost text) via engined's /openai/v1/completions.

engined.completions.neighbourContext.description: Send snippets from other open/recent editors as completions context. Only sent to a local (egress: none) completions route.

engined.defaultModels.image.markdownDescription: Model id for `engined_generateImage` (needs `/openai/v1/images/generations` or `/openai/v1/images/edits`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.defaultModels.ocr.markdownDescription: Model id for `engined_readImage` in `mode: "ocr"` (needs `/openai/v1/chat/completions` with `vision: "read"`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.defaultModels.vision.markdownDescription: Model id for `engined_readImage` in `mode: "describe"` (needs `/openai/v1/chat/completions` with `vision: "describe"`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.defaultModels.completion.markdownDescription: Model id for inline completions (needs `/openai/v1/completions`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.defaultModels.speech.markdownDescription: Model id for `engined_speak` (needs `/openai/v1/audio/speech`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.defaultModels.transcription.markdownDescription: Model id for `engined_transcribe` (needs `/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions`, and also used to translate when that row serves `/openai/v1/audio/translations`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.defaultModels.embedding.markdownDescription: Model id for `engined_search` (needs `/openai/v1/embeddings`). Empty is automatic. `engined: Choose default models` lists valid ids.

engined.search.allowRemote.description: Allow engined_search to embed/rerank through a non-local (egress != none) route. Off by default so workspace content never leaves the machine.

engined.search.maxChunks.description: Maximum number of chunks the search index will hold. Indexing stops (with a log message) once reached.

engined.chat.splitChunkChars.markdownDescription: Long user messages sent to engined are split into consecutive user turns of about this many characters, cut at blank lines, closing XML tags or line ends and never inside a code fence or JSON value. A hybrid model such as Ornith can only reuse a cached prompt up to a message boundary, so smaller pieces make new chats faster. `0` disables splitting.

engined.chat.splitAboveChars.markdownDescription: Only user messages longer than this many characters are split (see `engined.chat.splitChunkChars`). `0` disables splitting.

commands.title: engined: Use engined for All Chat Features

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external vscode --outfile dist/extension.cjs && bun run smoke
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bunx @vscode/vsce ls --no-dependencies >/dev/null
